train_note: Training assigns step = min(window_index, n_steps-1), so positional variation exists only in the first n_steps windows of a recording. This is a different rule from the one used at evaluation -- a train/test mismatch in the conditioning.
note: The pointer advances once per no-deviation WINDOW, while a recipe step spans many windows; it therefore reaches the last step early and clamps, leaving the graph context constant thereafter.
